name: Foundation Piecers
character: Add-a-quarter energy: numbered sections, a sharp grid, sage type for people who sew on paper on purpose.

sections.title: {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Numbered sections, an add-a-quarter ruler, and a short business meeting. We gather {{meeting_info}}.

items.title: Monthly pattern
items.body: A small FPP block, printed on newsprint, due at the following meeting.

items.title: Ruler clinic
items.body: Add-a-quarter, fold-back, and how to unpick section 7 without tearing the paper.

items.title: Show and tell
items.body: Unfinished sections welcome. We want to see the numbering, not only the finish.

sections.title: Bring an add-a-quarter ruler if you have one
sections.body: We keep a few extras. Dues cover the printed patterns.

sections.title: A guild that sews on paper
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Traditional piecers are welcome. The program assumes you have pulled a paper pattern at least once.

sections.html: {{guild_name}} meets {{meeting_info}} in {{city}}. We print the month's pattern on newsprint so you can stitch through it. Pull the paper after the block is pressed, not before.

items.quote: I had been avoiding FPP because of the numbering. Sitting next to someone who counts out loud fixed that.
items.author: Elena V.

sections.title: This year's blocks
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Twelve small foundations. Together they make a sampler, or stay as twelve minis.

items.title: Sharp points
items.body: January through April: stars and geese that actually meet.

items.title: Curves on paper
items.body: May through August: clamshells and drunkard's path on foundation.

items.title: Sampler set
items.body: September through December: sashing, joining, and a thin border.

sections.title: Meetings and clinics
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: A demo, then sewing. Irons at the back. Papers at the front table.

sections.note: Bring a small ruler, an add-a-quarter, and a paper-piecing foot if you have one.

sections.title: Membership
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Dues cover printed patterns and the hall. Guests may sew one pattern before joining.

items.q: Do I need a paper-piecing foot?
items.a: Helpful, not required. An open-toe foot and a short stitch length will do.

items.q: Can I print the pattern at home?
items.a: Members get a PDF in the newsletter. We still put newsprint copies on the table for people who want to stitch through paper.
